{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= Lights

|arg= local

|eff= local

|descr= Sets lightpoint in infrared range.

|s1= light [[setLightIR]] value

|p1= light: [[Object]] - object of class {{hl|"#lightpoint"}} or similar

|p2= value: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to make it visible ''only'' with night vision goggles, [[false]] to make it a normal light

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myLight setLightIR true; // visible with NVG only!</sqf>
